name: Quorum
summary: Quorum was a 2023 prototype for podcasts you could join: live conversations where listeners take part instead of only listening. It ran a waitlist and did not ship.
description: Quorum explored a question: what if a podcast were a conversation you could join? The prototype paired a mobile app with a landing page and a waitlist for early access.
It was built over a few weeks in December 2023 and January 2024 and did not go past the prototype stage.
